Subject: issue near Hanna, AB
Compliance Team,
I was patrolling the Okanagan Crossing Pipelines Ltd. line near Hanna, AB, on July 7. At 10:20,
I observed that the pipeline was being operated outside its design limits. No leak or release
occurred. I'm not sure what caused this, but I thought you should know.
The pipeline's operating conditions were not within the specified limits at the time. I didn't
see any other issues during my patrol.
Let me know if you need more info.
Sandi Patel
Pipeline Patrol Contractor
